title: Lishhhhmm
description: personal tweaks. it includes tweaks that i play with but are too few and random, and not worthy or enough to branch into their own project yet
body:
- circular crosshair
- transparent hud hotbar
- matching hud hotbar selection with the texture of the hud hotbar offhand
  - tuned down inner shadow for clearer look and feel of alignment of items when held
- hud armor lower corners smoothing and color adjustment to match the actual iron armor
- semi-transparent effect background & effect background ambient, at both hud and inventory
  - matching at inventory with at hud border size
  - reduced at inventory bottom area for cleaner alignment
- gui shield slot without icon (since it can hold other items as well)
- blinking Totem of Undying item texture
- recipe book button and button highlight texture experimentation
